$description: Bridgify design tokens. Single source for the design system pages and tokens.css. Values decided by the owner on the Foundations board, 21 Nov 2026, unless marked status: provisional. Format follows the W3C Design Tokens draft ($value, $type, $description).

desktop.$description: Content is at most 1560px wide and centred: 58px margin at 1440, 180 at 1920.

base.$description: Every dark section and the footer. One dark background; sections are separated by spacing and glass, not by a second shade.

cream.$description: Every light section. Cards on cream are separated by a hairline only.

primary.$description: Headings and primary text on dark. 15.6:1 on bg.base.

strong.$description: Emphasised UI labels and numbers on dark, and text on a filled coral button. 17.9:1.

body.$description: Running text on dark, including the footer. 11.6:1.

muted.$description: Dates, meta and quiet labels on dark. 8.3:1.

on-light-muted.$description: Meta on cream. 4.85:1 (replaces #786B64, which failed AA).

500.$description: Brand coral. Frames, icons, dots, focus; on cream also links and coral text (owner decision: kept as today, 2.53:1 on cream, below AA for small text).

300.$description: Links, Read more and step numbers on dark. 10.7:1.

ink-dark.$description: The second part of a two-part heading on dark.

ink-light.$description: The second part of a two-part heading on cream (unchanged from DESIGN.md).

button.$description: Filled primary button, resting. Hover: linear-gradient(105deg, #FFAD80, #F7704F).

success.$description: System states only (live, done). Never a brand colour.

quiet.$description: Edge of a quiet card and FAQ row lines on dark.

glass.$description: Peach edge of a glass surface.

display.$description: Headings and large numbers. Files: Chillax_Complete/Fonts (Light 300, Regular 400, Medium 500).

text.$description: Everything else. One family name only (the site also used 'Sofia'). File: Sofia_Sans/SofiaSans-VariableFont_wght.ttf.

code.$description: Code windows only. No Arial, no Georgia.

type.$description: Each role gives desktop, tablet and phone. clamp() values are fluid between the breakpoints. Letter spacing in em.

section-sm.use: Frequently asked questions and the closing CTA at the end of every page.

small-head.use: FAQ questions, article titles, list item titles.

stat.use: Large numbers (1M+, 3x). Weight 500 is reserved for numbers.

body.use: Running text and intros. Never below 16.

eyebrow.use: Section label above a title, with the 7px coral dot.

nav.use: Header menu, footer column titles and footer links.

caption.use: Dates, copyright, Back to top. Nothing outside illustrations is smaller than 12.

illustration-text-min.$description: Text inside illustrations (phone screens, diagrams, windows) scales with the art but is never smaller than 10px as seen. If it does not fit, shorten the illustration or show part of it.

long-demo.$description: Owner decision: a demo may be taller than the phone screen, as long as it scrolls with the page and never locks it. (Replaces MOBILE-RULES L2, the 85% limit.)

motion.$description: Phones play the same animations as desktop, starting when they come into view. Respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere.

pin.$description: A section pins on scroll only on screens at least 901px wide and 701px tall. Smaller screens get the phone behaviour.

space.$description: Approved 17 Nov 2026 (SPACING-GRID-PLAN.md, MOBILE-RULES.md). Phone values are the mobile layer's spacing table.

section-y.use: Top and bottom of every section.

hero-top.use: Header bar to the hero label.

gap-to-link.use: Text or buttons to a text link.

gap-to-control.use: Heading to tabs or a stepper.

gap-to-visual.use: Hero heading to the hero visual.

gap-to-foot.use: Content to a section's closing line.

radius.$description: Owner decision 21 Nov 2026: 12 / 18 / 30 / pill. Buttons keep their own 10px (decided separately).

sm.$description: Inputs, small tiles, images inside cards.

lg.$description: Large panels, stages, the closing CTA card.

button.$description: Every button, including the header buttons.

glow.$description: Reserved: one featured element per screen at most (for example a hero visual). Not part of the glass recipe.

glass.$description: The soft glass recipe (owner decision: no outer glow).

background.$value: radial-gradient(at 100% 0%, rgba(255,137,98,0.18), transparent 30%), radial-gradient(at 0% 100%, rgba(255,120,83,0.17), transparent 26%), linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,248,241,0.05), transparent 40%, rgba(255,248,241,0.03)), rgba(20,13,11,0.95)

blur.$description: backdrop-filter, only where the glass sits over imagery.

button.use: Actions. Primary: one per group, filled coral. Secondary: transparent with a coral edge. Same shapes on dark and on cream; on cream the secondary text is #180F10.
button.tapArea: 44px on phone (an invisible area around the 40px button)
button.arrow: Always ↗, after the label (owner decision). No ↘, →, or arrow square.
button.group: Buttons in one group share one width on phone and sit 12px apart (space.gap-actions-inner).

primary.rest: bg color.coral.button, text #180F10, border coral 500, inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,217,194,0.53)

header-button.use: LOG IN (secondary) and BOOK A DEMO ↗ (primary) in the header, on every device.

link.use: Go to another page or read more. Never drawn as a button.
link.color: coral 300 on dark, coral 500 on cream

states.hover / focus: colour warms to #FFE2C6 on dark; the arrow steps 3px up and right

chip.use: Filters and categories (blog, press, map filters).

card-quiet.use: Lists and grids of equal items.

card-glass.use: Featured panels and the frames around illustrations. No solid coral frames anywhere (owner decision).

stepper.use: Scroll-linked steps (Why Bridgify, Hotels stay, API customer experience). One style everywhere: number and a small uppercase label (owner decision).
stepper.label: 13 / 550 Sofia Sans, uppercase, 0.12em; #A99D94 at rest, #FFF8F1 when active
stepper.track: 2px on the start edge, rgba(178,138,104,0.24); fills with coral 500 as the step plays
stepper.phone: Steps stack above their preview; no pinning below 901px wide.

tabs.use: Parallel content inside a section or illustration. Segmented control (owner decision).

faq.use: Frequently asked questions on every page.
faq.question: type.small-head (20 desktop / 18 phone, Chillax 300)
faq.icon: + in coral 500, turns to − when open
faq.behaviour: Several can be open. Opens on click and on Enter or Space.

icon.use: Line icons in the Bridgify set.
icon.dot: Every icon carries the light dot: #FFE2C6 fill, 0.5px coral 500 stroke

pattern.$description: Section patterns and how each behaves per device. Owner decisions on the Patterns board, 21 Nov 2026. "img" is the example section as it looks today (1440, 768, 390).

heading.name: Heading block
heading.example: Every section: label, title, intro, buttons.
heading.desktop: Split: title on the left; intro and buttons on the right, the intro's first line level with the title's.
heading.phone: Stacked. Buttons one under the other, full width and the same width.

hero-demo.name: Hero with a demo
hero-demo.example: Hotels, Travel technology, API, Airlines, Loyalty.
hero-demo.desktop: Heading block, then the demo across the content width.
hero-demo.tablet: Heading block stacked, then the demo.
hero-demo.phone: As built today: the phone version uses its own scroll-driven demo. Keep it (owner decision).
hero-demo.note: Owner asked to be reminded if a phone demo here conflicts with a rule.

hero-center.name: Centred hero
hero-center.desktop: Centred title (two lines), intro and buttons centred.

pinned-steps.name: Pinned steps
pinned-steps.example: Why Bridgify (home), Hotels stay, API customer experience.
pinned-steps.desktop: The section pins; the stepper advances with scroll and the preview changes.
pinned-steps.tablet: Pins when the screen is at least 901 wide and 701 tall (rule.pin); otherwise as phone.
pinned-steps.phone: As today: the scroll-driven phone version stays (the section holds and the steps advance as the reader scrolls; Why Bridgify keeps its tabs). The step buttons take the stepper look: number and uppercase label on a 2px track, the active one in coral; the row scrolls to keep the active step in view.
pinned-steps.change: Today the step buttons are boxed pills or chips. Restyle them in the stepper look; the behaviour stays.
pinned-steps.note: Owner decision, 21 Nov 2026, after testing on a phone: keep the pinned, scroll-driven behaviour of Hotels stay, Airlines journey, Super apps and Why Bridgify.

card-grid.name: Grid of equal cards
card-grid.example: Choose how to integrate (solutions pages), Products (home).

demo-columns.name: Columns, each with a demo
demo-columns.desktop: 3 columns, each with text and a small demo, wired to a bar underneath.
demo-columns.tablet: As desktop if it fits, else as phone.
demo-columns.phone: Swipe sideways: one column per screen with a peek of the next and position dots; the bar sits underneath (as today).

two-sides.name: Two sides joined by wires
two-sides.example: Your team builds the interface / We manage the supply layer (API).
two-sides.desktop: Two cards side by side, wires between them.
two-sides.phone: A segmented switch above; one side at a time (as today).

tabs-preview.name: Tabs with a preview
tabs-preview.example: Use cases (Loyalty), OTAs and Airlines touchpoints.
tabs-preview.desktop: Tab list on the left, preview on the right.
tabs-preview.tablet: As desktop if it fits, else as phone.
tabs-preview.phone: Accordion: each tab opens in place and shows its preview under it.
tabs-preview.change: Today the phone shows a row of tab buttons above one preview. Build it as an accordion.

stats.name: Row of figures
stats.desktop: All figures in one row with dividers.

compare.name: Comparison
compare.phone: A segmented switch between the two (as today).

text-visual.name: Text beside a visual
text-visual.desktop: Text on the left, visual on the right.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.desktop: Days on the left, the demo on the right.

feature-list.name: Feature list with icons
feature-list.example: one API, ready for enterprise scale (API).

closing-cta.name: Closing CTA
closing-cta.example: The last section of every page.
closing-cta.desktop: Card: text and button on the left; selector or visual on the right.
closing-cta.phone: As today: text, button, then the selector or visual.

footer.name: Footer
footer.phone: Accordion groups that open with + (as today).

faq.name: FAQ section
faq.desktop: Title (type-section-sm), then the FAQ component across the content width.

text.name: Editorial text
text.example: About (our story, HBX), Developers access, Contact, Press enquiries.
text.desktop: Heading block; body in one or two columns of at most 68 characters.

form.name: Form
form.desktop: Heading on the left, fields on the right in one column.
form.phone: Stacked; every field full width, 44px tall at least.

article-list.name: Article list
article-list.desktop: Filter chips and search, then 4 article cards per row.

role-list.name: Role list
role-list.desktop: Roles grouped by team: title, place and an Apply link per row.
role-list.phone: Each role stacked: title, then place and the link.
